universe_screen.query: Market Capitalization > 12000 AND Price to earning < Industry PE AND Price to earning > 0 AND Return on equity > 12 AND Debt to equity < 1 AND Pledged percentage < 20 AND Current price > DMA 50 AND DMA 50 > DMA 200 AND Current price > High price * 0.75
universe_screen.source: Rebuilt: Nifty 500 constituents (niftyindices CSV) -> Yahoo 1y daily (technicals, computed) -> screener.in company pages (fundamentals; PE/mcap/PB rescaled to the 13-Nov NSE close where the page showed another price) -> screener.in industry pages (industry PE) -> NSE SHP XBRL (pledge)

technical_rules.A: close > SMA50 > SMA200 and close > 0.75 x 52wH (literal query)
technical_rules.B: close > SMA50, SMA50 <= SMA200 but SMA200 rising over 20 sessions, close > 0.75 x 52wH (secondary, flagged)

universe_screen.industry_pe_basis: Primary: median positive P/E of top-25-by-mcap peers on screener industry page 1. Secondary flag: median across all pages.

universe_screen.notes: Industry PE = median of positive P/E on the screener industry page(s) for the sub-sector; company P/E/mcap/PB taken from screener pages showing the 13-Nov close (pages fetched after 09:15 IST on 16-Nov show a live price and were rescaled to the 13-Nov NSE close by adjust_fundamentals.py). Pledge from NSE SHP XBRL (latest filed quarter). Names with no promoter group: pledge N/A (not a fail).

universe_screen_financials.query: Mcap > 12000 AND PE > 0 AND PB < sub-sector peer median PB (fallback PB < 3 when no peer median) AND ROE > 12 AND technical pass (rule A or B); D/E ignored

track_b_5k.purpose: Pre-fetched 5,000-12,000 Cr band, used ONLY if the analyst's mcap relaxation triggers (Stage 3 survivors < 10 at 12,000 Cr).
track_b_5k.universe: Nifty Microcap 250 (niftyindices CSV) + Nifty 500 names with screener mcap 5,000-12,000 Cr
track_b_5k.momentum_test: close >= 0.75 x 52wH AND close > SMA50 AND (SMA50 > SMA200 OR SMA200 rising 20s) AND 3M return > Nifty 500 3M return (0.26%)
track_b_5k.value_test: 5k<=mcap<=12k & PE>0 & PE<IndPE(top25) & ROE>12 & D/E<1 (non-fin) & pledge<20 & ADV20>=25Cr

setup_c_candidates.definition: Nifty 500 / Microcap 250 names with a Q2 FY27 results board meeting 19 Oct - 15 Nov 2026 (NSE board-meeting API, past dates). Results timestamp from NSE corporate-announcements. Reaction session = results day if filed before 15:30 IST, else next session. Post-result move = reaction-session open vs prior close (after-market filings) or reaction-day close vs prior close (intraday filings). Held = every close since the reaction session >= the pre-result close. Eligible = move > 0, held, >= 3 sessions, mcap >= 5,000 Cr, ADV >= 25 Cr.
setup_c_candidates.reaction_pending_or_lt3_sessions_note: names with reaction session 11/12/13-Nov have < 3 sessions -> see watch_held_lt3_sessions / rows
